sentences.text: Shri Akhilendra Singh - Public Prosecutor for responden Heard on I.A. No.5518/2022 which is the first application under Section 389(1) of the Cr.P.C., 1973 for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellant Dinesh @ Bhooru.

This appeal has been preferred against the judgment of conviction and sentence dated 06/01/2022 passed by Special Judge (POCSO Act) Harsood, District Khandwa (M.P.) in Special Case No.21/2019, whereby appellant has been convicted and sentenced as under:
Conviction U/s. Imprisonment Fine

entities.text: Special Judge (POCSO Act) Harsood, District Khandwa (M.P.)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In lieu of default 376(3) of IPC R.I. for 20 years Rs.1,000/- R.I. for 3 months Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
There is no sign of force applied on the body of the victim.
He further submits that the appellant has already undergone almost 6 years of incarceration and has no previous criminal history.
This appeal is of the year 2022 and conclusion of appeal will take time.
The appellant is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by the directions and conditions, which may be imposed by this Court.
Hence, it is prayed that the application for suspension of sentence may be allowed.

Learned Public Prosecutor, on the other hand, has opposed the application and supported the impugned judgment of conviction and sentence passed by the trial court.
Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties and looking to the overall facts and circumstances of the case
, we are of the opinion that the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant can be considered.
Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, I.A. No.5518/2022 is allowed.

It is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, the remaining jail sentence of the appellant is hereby suspended and he be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court with a further direction to appear before the Registry of Dinesh Alias Bhooru vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105250291/
